name: EPD Air Quality Health Index (past 24 h, all stations)
info: Hourly AQHI per monitoring station. The feed covers the past 24 h, so polling every 30 min with upserts never misses an hour.

Index definitions
func:
// Run once at start-up: indexes that make upserts and time-range queries fast
const idx = [
  ['aqhi',              {station: 1, time: 1}, {unique: true}],
  ['aqhi',              {time: 1}, {}],
  ['ae_waiting',        {hospital: 1, updateTime: 1}, {unique: true}],
  ['ae_waiting',        {updateTime: 1}, {}],
  ['journey_time',      {from: 1, to: 1, captureTime: 1}, {unique: true}],
  ['journey_time',      {captureTime: 1}, {}],
  ['traffic_speed',     {snapshotTime: 1}, {unique: true}],
  ['carpark_vacancy',   {slotTime: 1}, {unique: true}],
  ['carpark_info',      {park_Id: 1}, {unique: true}],
  ['weather_warnings',  {observedAt: 1}, {}],
  ['hko_regional',      {station: 1, time: 1}, {unique: true}],
  ['hko_regional',      {time: 1}, {}],
  ['Weather Report',    {updateTime: 1}, {}]
];
return [idx.map(([c, k, o]) => ({collection: c, operation: 'createIndex', payload: [k, o]}))];

label: Analysis
info: Periodic analyses over the collected data (MongoDB aggregation pipelines + JavaScript). Every result is stored in the `analytics` collection and broadcast on the analytics bus for the dashboards.

name: Query runner (called with link call): msg.queries -> msg.results
info: Each query is {key, collection, pipeline}. The runner sends them one at a time to a generic mongodb3 node (operation aggregate.toArray) and stores each result under msg.results[key].
